title: Volume is attached but not visible in OS
problem: A newly created storage volume is attached in the Console but doesn't show up in `df -h`.
symptoms: df -h does not list the new drive
cause: The raw block device needs to be partitioned, formatted, and mounted by the operating system.
solution: Run `lsblk` to identify the new block device (e.g., /dev/vdb).
Mount it to a directory like `/mnt/data`.
Add an entry to `/etc/fstab` for persistence.
